title: Samsung, Dexcom, and recent Android patch
symptom: Some Samsung phones have difficulty after a recent (June 2023) Samsung patch, affecting Bluetooth operation. Users report irregular readings, signal dropping in and out, and connectivity issues with xDrip and other apps.
cause: The thread indicates the issue is likely caused by a Samsung system update (June 2023 patch) that affects Bluetooth operation, and is not specific to xDrip as many apps have this problem. A later Samsung update on July 24th was expected to fix it.
fix: The thread suggests trying the latest xDrip Nightly release (2023.07.02) which improved connectivity for some, and enabling OB1 debugging for logs. A user reported that after a subsequent Samsung update on July 24th, the issue was resolved. Another user found that changing Bluetooth battery optimization setting improved connection.
settings_changed: Bluetooth battery optimization → changed (from battery optimization to not optimized)
evidence_quote: Today Samsung push update for A53, and after update its working ;-)
